purpose: Explicit target and execution policy for Intel Macs and Apple Silicon in Chimera II OS

targets.execution: requires an x86_64 Chimera kernel, boot path, drivers and userland
targets.macos_binary_compatibility: not implied; Mach-O, dyld, Apple frameworks and code-signing semantics need separate implementations

targets.execution: requires an AArch64 Chimera kernel, firmware/boot path, platform drivers and userland
targets.hardware: Apple M-series systems share the AArch64 ISA family but platform firmware, device trees, interrupt controllers, power management and device drivers are platform-specific
targets.macos_binary_compatibility: not implied; Rosetta 2 is an Apple technology and is not included by this target

required: separate validated x86_64 and aarch64 slices
universal_binary.note: A target label alone does not create or execute a universal binary.

validation_gates: boot smoke test on matching emulator or hardware
